label: FICTIONAL and SYNTHETIC: Palmer example, not real data

types.name: Password reset
types.cost_example: Low: customer stays locked out a little longer

examples.ticket: I've forgotten my password and the reset email isn't arriving.
examples.reply: Sent a new reset link and asked them to check spam for an email from Palmer.

examples.ticket: Can you reset my password? I changed jobs and lost access to my old email.
examples.reply: Explained that the account owner must change the login email first, and how to ask them.

examples.ticket: Reset link says expired.
examples.reply: Sent a fresh link and explained links expire after 30 minutes.

types.name: Can't log in
types.cost_example: Low: customer tries again or asks for a person

examples.ticket: My 2-step code isn't arriving by text.
examples.reply: Sent the code by email instead and showed how to update the phone number.

examples.ticket: It says my account is locked.
examples.reply: Unlocked after the failed-attempt timeout and sent a reset link.

examples.ticket: I can't log in on my phone but it works on my laptop.
examples.reply: Told them to clear the app cache.
examples.note: The app needed an update; clearing the cache didn't fix it

types.name: Missing payslip
types.cost_example: Low: employee is pointed to the wrong month

examples.ticket: One of my staff can't find her March payslip.
examples.reply: Showed where payslips sit under Employees > Documents and how to resend March.

examples.ticket: Where do employees download payslips?
examples.reply: Linked the employee app guide and the resend option.

examples.ticket: Payslip for last Friday isn't showing.
examples.reply: Explained payslips appear once the payroll run is approved, and that it is still in draft.

types.name: Update company address
types.cost_example: Medium: tax letters go to the old address

examples.ticket: We've moved office, how do I change our address?
examples.reply: Updated the registered address after confirming the account owner, and noted tax letters follow in 1 to 2 weeks.

examples.ticket: Change our trading address to 14 Mill Lane.
examples.reply: Updated the trading address and left the registered address unchanged, as asked.

examples.ticket: Our address on payslips is wrong.
examples.reply: Showed that payslips use the trading address and updated it.

types.name: Add a new employee
types.cost_example: Medium: employee set up on the wrong pay schedule

examples.ticket: How do I add someone starting Monday?
examples.reply: Walked through Add employee and the tax details needed before the first run.

examples.ticket: New starter is part time, 3 days a week.
examples.reply: Set up a part-time contract with pro-rata salary.

examples.ticket: Adding a weekly-paid worker to our monthly payroll.
examples.reply: Added them to the monthly schedule.
examples.note: Should have created a weekly pay schedule first

types.name: Change bank details
types.cost_example: High: payroll paid from or to the wrong account

examples.ticket: We've switched banks, need to update the account payroll is paid from.
examples.reply: Drafted the change and asked for owner approval and a verification call before it takes effect.

examples.ticket: Employee gave me new bank details.
examples.reply: Drafted the update on the employee record, flagged for a person to check against the signed form.

examples.ticket: Change our company account number, urgent, payroll is tomorrow.
examples.reply: Drafted the change for tomorrow's run.
examples.note: Changes inside 3 days of a run need a manual check; it should have flagged the deadline

examples.ticket: You charged us twice this month.
examples.reply: Confirmed the duplicate charge and proposed a refund of the second payment.

examples.ticket: We cancelled in January but were billed in February.
examples.reply: Proposed a full refund for February.
examples.note: Cancellation took effect at the end of February, so no refund was due

examples.ticket: Can I get a refund for the unused months on our annual plan?
examples.reply: Explained the annual plan terms and proposed a pro-rata refund for review.

examples.ticket: Payroll failed with a bank error.
examples.reply: Identified an expired bank authorisation and showed how to renew it, then rerun.

examples.ticket: Run failed, says tax code missing for 2 employees.
examples.reply: Listed the 2 employees and where to add their tax codes.

examples.ticket: Payroll didn't go through and staff are asking where their pay is.
examples.reply: Told them to rerun payroll.
examples.note: Payment was already sent; rerunning would have paid staff twice

types.name: Tax form question
types.cost_example: Medium: customer files with the wrong figure

examples.ticket: Where do I find the year-end tax forms for my staff?
examples.reply: Showed Reports > Year end and how to send forms to employees.

examples.ticket: Why is the tax on this form different from the payslips?
examples.reply: Explained the form includes a correction made in November.

examples.ticket: Do I need to file anything for a contractor?
examples.reply: Said contractors are filed the same way as employees.

types.name: Cancel subscription
types.cost_example: High: account and payroll history closed by mistake

examples.ticket: We're closing the business, how do I cancel?
examples.reply: Explained the final payroll steps, how to export records, then drafted the cancellation for approval.

examples.ticket: Cancel at the end of this month please.
examples.reply: Drafted the cancellation for the end of the month and listed what to export first.

examples.ticket: Thinking of cancelling, what happens to our data?
examples.reply: Explained records are kept for 6 years and can be exported any time.

types.name: Change pay date
types.cost_example: High: staff paid on the wrong day

examples.ticket: Can we pay staff on the 25th instead of the last day?
examples.reply: Showed how to change the pay date from next month and the bank cut-off.

examples.ticket: Bank holiday on payday, can we pay a day early?
examples.reply: Moved this month's pay date one working day earlier.

examples.ticket: Move this month's pay date to tomorrow.
examples.reply: Moved the pay date to tomorrow.
examples.note: Tomorrow is past the bank cut-off; staff would have been paid late

types.name: Invoice question
types.cost_example: Low: customer is confused about a charge

examples.ticket: What is this extra charge on our invoice?
examples.reply: Explained the charge is for 2 employees added mid-month.

examples.ticket: Can I get a copy of last month's invoice?
examples.reply: Sent the invoice and showed where invoices are kept.

examples.ticket: Why did our price go up?
examples.reply: Said prices rose for all customers.
examples.note: Their price rose because they moved to a bigger plan

examples.ticket: How is holiday pay worked out for part-time staff?
examples.reply: Explained pro-rata holiday based on contracted days.

examples.ticket: Employee says her holiday pay is too low.
examples.reply: Said the calculation was correct.
examples.note: Overtime should have been included in her holiday pay

examples.ticket: How do I record 2 days of leave?
examples.reply: Showed how to add leave on the employee's calendar.

examples.ticket: Need a payroll summary for our accountant.
examples.reply: Exported the summary for the last tax year as a spreadsheet.

examples.ticket: How do I export last quarter?
examples.reply: Showed the date filter on Reports and exported Q3.

examples.ticket: Can I get a list of all employees with salaries?
examples.reply: Exported the employee list with salaries.

types.name: Pension deduction question
types.cost_example: Medium: wrong deduction explained to staff

examples.ticket: Why has pension been taken from a new starter?
examples.reply: Explained automatic enrolment after the waiting period.

examples.ticket: Employee wants to opt out of the pension.
examples.reply: Showed how to record the opt-out and refund the first deduction.

examples.ticket: Pension amount looks wrong this month.
examples.reply: Said it was correct.
examples.note: A salary change hadn't been passed to the pension calculation
